{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}

{"type":"thought","data":" 294 shares for 100 "}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Yes side shows"}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe default max-price"}

{"type":"thought","data":"I am now weighing whether"}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-02c1e9df-e52f-479f-8f9f-c17310ab7366-7","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'\nimport math\n\ndef pois(k, lam):\n    return math.exp(-lam) * lam**k / math.factorial(k)\n\ndef match_probs(lb, ls, maxg=10):\n    pb = [pois(i, lb) for i in range(maxg+1)]\n    ps = [pois(i, ls) for i in range(maxg+1)]\n    # tail\n    pb.append(1-sum(pb)); ps.append(1-sum(ps))\n    hw=dr=aw=0\n    for i,pbi in enumerate(pb):\n        for j,psj in enumerate(ps):\n            p=pbi*psj\n            if i>j: hw+=p\n            elif i==j: dr+=p\n            else: aw+=p\n    return hw, dr, aw\n\nscenarios = [\n    (2.2, 0.6),\n    (2.0, 0.7),\n    (1.9, 0.8),\n    (2.38, 0.89),  # squawka\n    (1.8, 0.75),\n    (1.7, 0.9),\n    (2.4, 0.5),\n    (1.6, 1.0),\n]\nprint(f\"{'lamB':>6} {'lamS':>6} {'P(win)':>8} {'P(draw)':>8} {'P(loss)':>8} {'P(No)':>8}\")\nfor lb, ls in scenarios:\n    hw, dr, aw = match_probs(lb, ls)\n    print(f\"{lb:6.2f} {ls:6.2f} {hw:8.3f} {dr:8.3f} {aw:8.3f} {dr+aw:8.3f}\")\n\n# devig pinnacle and others\nbooks = {\n    \"pinnacle\": (1.47, 4.84, 6.08),\n    \"oddsrun_avg\": (1.46, 4.50, 5.65),\n    \"bet365\": (1.50, 4.20, 5.75),\n    \"wh\": (1.44, 4.40, 5.50),\n    \"bookmaker\": (1.50, 4.70, 5.60),\n    \"espn_-210_guess\": (100/210+1, 4.5, 5.5),  # rough\n    \"vbet\": (1.41, 4.40, 5.40),\n    \"everygame\": (1.40, 4.40, 5.50),\n    \"best_outlier\": (1.52, 4.79, 6.25),\n}\nprint(\"\\nDevigged home win probs:\")\nfor name, (h,d,a) in books.items():\n    ih, id_, ia = 1/h, 1/d, 1/a\n    s = ih+id_+ia\n    print(f\"{name:20} raw {ih:.3f} devig {ih/s:.3f} no {1-ih/s:.3f} overround {s:.3f}\")\n\n# EV if buy no at 0.34 and yes at 0.67\nprint(\"\\nEV per 100 stake\")\nfor p_yes in [0.61, 0.62, 0.63, 0.64, 0.647, 0.65, 0.66, 0.67, 0.68, 0.70]:\n    p_no = 1-p_yes\n    # yes at 0.67\n    yes_profit = 100/0.67 - 100\n    ev_yes = p_yes*yes_profit - p_no*100\n    # no at 0.34\n    no_profit = 100/0.34 - 100\n    ev_no = p_no*no_profit - p_yes*100\n    # no at 0.335 mid\n    no_profit2 = 100/0.335 - 100\n    ev_no2 = p_no*no_profit2 - p_yes*100\n    print(f\"pYes {p_yes:.3f}  EVyes@0.67 {ev_yes:+6.2f}  EVno@0.34 {ev_no:+6.2f}  EVno@0.335 {ev_no2:+6.2f}\")\nPY","description":"Compute win probabilities and bet EV"},"content":[],"locations":[]}
